topics.name: A sustained project developing from initial engagement to a realised outcome
Preparatory period responding to a starting point
10 hours of supervised time producing a final outcome

connections.why: Recording from observation and sources gives the raw material that developing ideas builds on
Initial ideas are refined through experiment with media, techniques and processes
Refinement leads to a resolved, personal final outcome
The personal response must clearly connect back to the ideas first developed
The sustained portfolio project is where AO1 development is evidenced over time
A sustained project is judged on how convincingly it reaches a realised outcome
Further work demonstrates the same skills shown in the main sustained project
Preparatory study directly informs the supervised final outcome in the ESA
Skills and working methods built in the portfolio are reapplied in ESA preparation
Fine art is one route through which the broad 'art, craft and design' title can be answered
Graphic communication is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Textile design is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Three-dimensional design is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Photography is one of the specialist titles within art, craft and design
Observational recording underpins development whatever specialist title is chosen
